summary: A free MIT AI gateway offering a single endpoint for over 359 providers and 1200+ models, featuring token compression, quota‑aware fallback, and support for desktop and PWA applications.
usecases: Simplify integration of multiple LLM providers into a single API for developers
Manage costs by automatically falling back to cheaper providers when quotas are exceeded
Add AI capabilities to desktop or progressive web apps via a unified gateway
ideas: Create an IDE plug‑in that lets users query OmniRoute directly from their development environment
Build a dashboard that visualizes token usage and cost across all provider connections
Combine OmniRoute with MCP/A2A to enable agent‑based workflows that can switch models dynamically
